verseText: ...that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth...
meaning: One day, every human being who has ever lived will bow down before king King Jesus.

recall.question: What will every knee do at the name of Jesus?

meaning.question: What does this show about Jesus?
choices: He is the King everyone will acknowledge
He is only one teacher among many
He has authority only in one place

application.prompt: Honor Jesus as King today by choosing to obey Him willingly.
